definitions.explanation: A color that is opposite another on the color wheel. When placed side by side, complementary colors create strong contrast; when mixed, they produce a neutral tone.

examples.english: The complementary color of red is green.

examples.japanese: {補色|ほしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using complementary colors makes a design eye-catching.

examples.japanese: {補色|ほしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Placing colors in a complementary relationship next to each other creates an effect where they enhance one another.

notes:
Compound of {補|ほ} (supplement, complement) + {色|しょく} (color). A technical term from color theory, used in art, design, fashion, and photography.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補色|ほしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: complementary color relationship
- {補色|ほしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧: to combine complementary colors
- {補色|ほしょく}⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧: complementary contrast
- {補色|ほしょく}{残像|ざんぞう}: complementary afterimage

COMMON COMPLEMENTARY PAIRS:
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: red and green
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦オレンジ→オレンジ：01044_orenji⟧: blue and orange
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧: yellow and purple

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
{補色|ほしょく} (complementary color) is distinct from ⟦{捕食|ほしょく}→捕食：12819_hoshoku⟧ (predation, catching prey). Context makes the difference clear.
